name: Tyler Posey
bio: Tyler Garcia-Posey (born October 18, 1991) is an American actor, musician, and producer. He performed in his early years in a number of children's film and television roles, for which he was twice nominated for a Young Artist Award. He was most notable as Raul Garcia in Doc and Ty Ventura in Maid in Manhattan. Later on as a teenager, he is best known for his role as Scott McCall in the fantasy series Teen Wolf.
